title: CELEBRITY: a watch a trusted outlet reported a celebrity wearing (recent)
why: Owner asked for a celebrity post tonight. New owner rule (21 Nov): ONE trusted outlet naming the watch is enough, credited by name (spotted by GQ); do not look for a second outlet. Prefer a sighting from the last few weeks with a clear photo of the person (brand campaign or free-licence photo) and an official photo of the watch. Not Tyson Fury.
